pcy.text: The Keldon Necropolis is the burial place of the Witch-Kings in Keld, where Latulla returns to push the warlords to awaken the Witch Kings but is defeated in ritual combat by Gorsha, who kills Druik and exiles her with her supporters.
Later Eladamri and Astor's armies make a stand against the Phyrexians there, where Phyrexian necromancy raises Keldon dead as thralls.
Tajamin strikes a risen hero and the cudgel catches fire, and when he hurls it down it melts the glacier and floods the battlefield, and the Golden Argosy arrives and rescues survivors.
